body:
## 检查更新与下载

- Apple 芯片 Mac 检查更新失败时，「设置 → 版本信息」会显示「下载最新安装包」。点击即可从浏览器下载官网提供的正式 DMG。
- 两个更新来源都要求等待时，Renamint 会显示较早可以重试的本地日期和时间。

从 1.24.0 或 1.24.1 升级时，看到「发现新版本」即可点击「下载更新」。如果旧版一直提示「检查过于频繁」，可以稍后再试，也可以直接下载本页的安装包。退出 Renamint，将新版拖入「应用程序」即可完成安装。适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，最低系统为 macOS 26。

## Checking for updates and downloading

- If a check fails on an Apple silicon Mac, choose “Download latest installer” in Settings to download the same official DMG offered on the website.
- When both update sources ask Renamint to wait, the app shows the earliest local date and time you can try again.

If you’re upgrading from 1.24.0 or 1.24.1, choose “Download Update” when a new release is offered. If the old app keeps saying “Too many requests,” try again later or download the installer on this release page. Quit Renamint and drag the new app into Applications. Requires an Apple silicon Mac running macOS 26 or later.
